response.answer: Konstantinos Meletis is a leading researcher in brain circuits and neuroimaging, known for his work on explainable AI for MRI at Karolinska Institutet. His group investigates brain mechanisms underlying psychiatric disorders. He focuses on brain circuits regulating behavior and decision-making.
